summary: Katako-Kombe territory (Sankuru) covers Katako-Kombe town and the Katako Kombe, Wembo Nyama and Djalo Djeka secteurs in the Tetela heartland, far from the eastern armed conflicts and outside the core Kamuina Nsapu theatre. Insecurity is mostly banditry, chieftaincy/land disputes and episodic political unrest, not territorial armed-group control. All locations are assessed as under ordinary state authority with the PNC as the main permanent force (FARDC and ANR present in the territorial seat). Live web research was unavailable for this run, so confidence is medium for the town and low for rural areas.

zones.description: Katako-Kombe town (territorial seat, Cite Nouvelle and adjoining localities within ~6 km)
zones.evidence: Katako-Kombe is the territorial seat with territorial administration, PNC commissariat, tribunal de paix and ANR antenna; a small FARDC detachment is present. Insecurity is limited to banditry, political/chieftaincy tensions and occasional unrest handled by the PNC; no armed group is known to hold or administer any part of the town. Live web research was unavailable for this run (search budget exhausted and news/aggregator sites blocked by the egress proxy), so the assessment rests on background knowledge and the default-state-presence rule.

zones.description: Rural Katako Kombe secteur villages (Katako Kombe and Dikungu health zones)
zones.evidence: Rural villages under thin PNC posts, territorial administration and customary chiefs; local conflicts are land/chieftaincy disputes and banditry, with no organised armed group known to control or tax localities. Live web research was unavailable for this run (search budget exhausted and news/aggregator sites blocked by the egress proxy), so the assessment rests on background knowledge and the default-state-presence rule.

zones.description: Wembo Nyama secteur (Wembo Nyama, Dikungu, Tunda, Tshumbe health-zone villages incl. Osomba, Mbalasa, Dowe)
zones.evidence: Southern secteur of the territory toward Lubefu/Kibombo; Wembo Nyama is a mission and secteur centre with PNC presence. Not part of the eastern conflict zones or the 2016-2017 Kamuina Nsapu theatre; no armed group is known to control any locality. Live web research was unavailable for this run (search budget exhausted and news/aggregator sites blocked by the egress proxy), so the assessment rests on background knowledge and the default-state-presence rule.

zones.description: Djalo Djeka secteur (Djalo Ndjeka, Omendjadi, Dikungu, Vanga Kete and Katako Kombe health-zone villages, incl. Lokolonga, Kudi, Ekitahoka)
zones.evidence: Western, forested secteur bordering Lodja territory with sparse state presence (PNC posts, chefs de groupement); insecurity consists of banditry and local land or inter-community disputes, with no organised armed group known to hold territory. Live web research was unavailable for this run (search budget exhausted and news/aggregator sites blocked by the egress proxy), so the assessment rests on background knowledge and the default-state-presence rule.
